reasoning: Team USA is the clear betting favorite at -115/+110 odds, with what's described as potentially the strongest roster in WBC history, featuring elite pitching (Skubal, Skenes) and hitting (Judge, Harper, Schwarber). However, Japan (+330) is the defending champion with a perfect 7-0 record in 2023 and has never finished below third. The Dominican Republic (+400) also has a star-studded roster. While USA has home-field advantage for later rounds in Miami, the tournament's single-elimination format creates upset potential. USA won in 2017 but Japan has won 3 of 5 tournaments. Given USA's favoritism but tournament uncertainty, I estimate around 35-40% probability.
